## Primary Clinical Services
- Comprehensive Eye Health & Pediatric Vision Examinations
- Macular Degeneration & Retinal Diagnostics (AdaptDx Dark Adaptometer, Spectralis OCT)
- Dry Eye Center of Excellence (LipiFlow Thermal Pulsation & Tear Osmolarity)
- Specialty Contact Lenses (Scleral Lenses for Keratoconus, Orthokeratology Corneal Reshaping)
- Pediatric Myopia Control (halting progressive nearsightedness in children)
- 24/7 Acute Ocular Emergency Care (corneal foreign body removal, eye trauma, sudden flashes/floaters)
- Cataract & LASIK Surgical Co-Management
- Designer Optical Boutique (Over 1,200 designer frames)

## Insurances Accepted
VSP, EyeMed, Medicare, Highmark Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, UnitedHealthcare, Davis Vision, CareCredit 0% Financing.


## Detailed Equipment & Diagnostic Capabilities
- **AdaptDx Dark Adaptometer**: Detects early sub-clinical macular degeneration up to 3 years before visible structural changes appear on fundus examination.
- **Heidelberg Spectralis OCT**: High-resolution cross-sectional retinal layer scanning for glaucoma, macular edema, and diabetic retinopathy.
- **LipiFlow Thermal Pulsation**: In-office thermal and automated massage treatment clearing blocked meibomian glands for chronic evaporative dry eye.
- **Optomap Ultra-Widefield Retinal Imaging**: High-resolution panoramic view of the peripheral retina without mandatory chemical pupil dilation.
- **Humphrey Visual Field Analyzer**: Automated threshold visual field testing for glaucoma progression and neurological visual pathways.
